about: Input for tools/comfy/palette_extract.py: where each material is sampled on the approved front concept. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in concept pixels (1536x1024, origin top-left, x1/y1 exclusive); hue in degrees, sat/val in 0-1 (HSV), applied inside the boxes after the flat navy background is removed. tones = CIELAB L* percentiles reported as shadow/base/highlight (emissive: rim/hot/core). The concept is the verbatim approved front (with the two revolvers, which are weapons and are not sampled). Edit a box, re-run the tool, look at reports/stage0_palette_samples.png.
title: KAEL
subtitle: The Wraithshot  -  colour callouts
header_note: Measured from the approved front concept (references/KAEL_front_approved.png). Derived data, not new design. The serpent revolvers in his hands are weapons (separate models) and are not sampled.
value_note: Kael is one DARK block (violet-black coat, black shirt and trousers, L* 8-20) cut by two warm mid accents (worn brown leather and bronze buckles) and ONE cool light: the spectral ghost-green (his left arm, the left eye and face glow, the gem buckle, the coat's ghost-flame tatters). The ghost green is emissive and sits above everything; it must stay teal-mint, clear of the P4 player ring green #5BE37D. At game scale he reads as a dark, flared coat with a glowing arm.

swatches.label: Violet duster coat
swatches.note: the long tattered duster, collar and cuffs: dark violet-black; lit faces lift toward the highlight tone

swatches.label: Maroon loin cloth
swatches.note: the torn cloth hanging from the belt between the legs; same family as the coat, a touch redder

swatches.label: Black shirt & trousers
swatches.note: shirt, scarf, trousers and the fingerless glove: near-black, slightly cool

swatches.label: Worn brown leather
swatches.note: belts, holster, thigh straps, bracers and the boot cuffs

swatches.label: Boots
swatches.note: buckled dark-brown boots with strap plates; darker than the belts

swatches.label: Bronze buckles & cartridges
swatches.note: belt buckle ring, strap buckles, cartridge caps, the coat's worn edge trim

swatches.label: Skin
swatches.note: tanned face, neck and his right (gloved) hand's fingers; tiny at game scale

swatches.label: Hair & stubble
swatches.note: dark swept hair, a lighter streak over the glowing side; short beard and stubble

swatches.label: Spectral arm
swatches.note: his LEFT arm below the sleeve (image right) and the ghost hand: translucent ghost flesh, emissive, unlit in the shader

swatches.label: Eye & face glow
swatches.note: the glowing left eye and the green creeping over the left side of the face

swatches.label: Ghost gem buckle
swatches.note: the green gem in the belt buckle and the collar pin: a small bright centre mark

swatches.label: Ghost-flame wisps
swatches.note: the spectral flame rising off the coat hem; built as a few chunky emissive tatters, not particles

pairs: one violet cloth family; the loin cloth a touch redder
the boots are the darker leather
the wisps are the same green, translucent over the navy: build them from the arm's tones
checks.content_note: the UI lilac is far lighter than the coat: the violet reads through lit coat faces and the UI only
checks.bg_note: the coat sits on the concept's navy by value; the ghost arm, the leather and the outline carry the silhouette
